lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in multiple vertical columns along the visible dorsal-lateral surface, extending from the posterior branchial region to the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot alignments, creating a grid-like matrix across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, displaying a sharp vertical gradient with high luminance on the dorsal edge and shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of discrete high-luminance blobs localized within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, primarily along the leading edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large, irregularly shaped high-reflectance patch on the upper lobe of the caudal fin, consistent with tissue abrasion or unique localized depigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal fish (remoras) attached to the ventral-lateral area posterior to the left pectoral fin and trailing the second dorsal fin.
